plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for GCOM Ethernet switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 13464). Chassis temperature, fan and PSU are not collected.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the GCOM Ethernet switch, computed as 100 minus cpuIdle when cpuIdle is in 0-100. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the GCOM Ethernet switch, computed as (memorySize - memoryIdle) / memorySize x 100 when size is positive and idle is in range.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of the GCOM Ethernet switch in bytes (gbnPlatformOAMSystem memorySize).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free memory of the GCOM Ethernet switch in bytes (gbnPlatformOAMSystem memoryIdle).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used memory of the GCOM Ethernet switch in bytes, derived as memorySize minus memoryIdle.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
